images.source: Google Play Books (名探偵コナン（１）, Shogakukan digital edition)
images.author: Gosho Aoyama / Shogakukan
images.why: Japanese Shonen Sunday Comics vol. 1 (Conan in deerstalker, Big Ben). 3180x4994 JPEG, flat cover, no padding/badges. Sharpness: MAD(50% down/up)=3.00 at native, 8.85 after resizing to 1800 long side (blurry Kobo 1650x2594 scores 0.37/0.40); 1:1 crop of the コナン logo shows crisp print halftone dots, i.e. a genuine high-res scan, not an upscale. Aspect 0.637, so a 3:4 crop trims ~15% of height (keep the title).

images.source: Google Play Books (美味しんぼ（１）, Shogakukan Big Comics digital edition)
images.author: Tetsu Kariya (story), Akira Hanasaki (art) / Shogakukan
images.why: Correct VOLUME 1 「豆腐と水」 (lobster platter, Yamaoka and Kaibara Yuzan). 2660x3753, flat, no padding. CAVEAT, fails the strict sharpness bar: MAD50=1.80 native / 1.37 at 1800, and it only rises below ~1400 px, so it is a clean upscale of a ~1200-1300 px master (1:1 crop is smooth with no JPEG blocking). Still clearly better than Kobo (0.28) and the best-resolved JP vol. 1 file found; fine when downscaled to an 800 px card.
